1071: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ; ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Service done in ego is not accepted;
one is born and dies, and comes and goes again.
ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ. ਸਾਈ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
That is perfect austerity, that is service, which is pleasing to my Lord's mind. ॥11॥
ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Which of Your virtues can I describe, O Master?
You are the Inner-knower of all beings.
ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
I beg this gift from You, O Creator: that night and day I may chant the Lord's Name. ॥12॥
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ; ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਣ ਕਾ ॥
Some have the strength of proud speech;
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ; ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ॥
some have the strength of Maya's backing.
ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ, ਨ ਕਾਈ; ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ ਰਾਖੁ. ਮੈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
I have no support or prop other than the Lord; O Creator, protect me, the humble one. ॥13॥
You give honour to the dishonoured, as it pleases You;
ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ; ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
countless others come and go, worn out and ruined.
ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਪਖੁ ਕਰਹਿ, ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਲ, ਤੁਧੁ ਆਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Those whose side You take, O Master — You make their word prevail. ॥14॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਿਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Those who ever meditated on the Lord's Name,
ਤਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
by the Guru's grace attained the supreme state.
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
One who served the Lord found peace; without service, people repent. ॥15॥
ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ॥
You pervade all, O Lord, Master of the world;
ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
that one meditates on the Lord on whose forehead is the Guru's hand.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ; ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
I have entered the Lord's refuge and chant the Lord; servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ॥16॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
He who created power and established the earth,
who holds up the sky on the support of His command,
ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਇ. ਈਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ. ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
who created fire and bound it in wood — that God protects all, O brother. ॥1॥
He who delivers sustenance to all beings and creatures,
the all-powerful Cause of causes, Himself (detached),
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ; ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
who in an instant establishes and disestablishes — He alone is your helper. ॥2॥
He who cherished you in the mother's womb,
who was with you, caring for you with every breath and morsel —
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਵਡੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
forever and ever meditate on that Beloved, whose glory is great. ॥3॥
In an instant He turns sultans and khans into worms;
God exalts the poor and makes them lords.
ਗਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ. ਸਰਬ ਸਧਾਰਣ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Destroyer of pride, support of all — His worth cannot be told at all. ॥4॥
He alone is honourable, he alone is wealthy,
in whose mind the Lord God dwells.
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
He who created this universe is mother, father, son, kinsman and brother. ॥5॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਸਰਣਾ; ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Coming to God's refuge there is nothing to fear;
in the company of the holy one is certainly carried across.
ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
One who worships the Creator in thought, word and deed never suffers punishment. ॥6॥
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
One in whose mind and body the Treasure of virtues pervades
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਜੋਨਿ, ਨ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
does not wander through the cycle of birth and death.
ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ. ਕੀਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ; ਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
His pains are destroyed; he makes his dwelling in peace, satisfied and fulfilled. ॥7॥
1072: the Inner-knower, in every place and interspace.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Remembering, remembering the Perfect Transcendent Lord, anxiety and calculation are erased. ॥8॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
The Lord's Name is (like) millions and hundreds of thousands of arms;
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ, ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
the Lord's praise and kirtan is the wealth he carries.
ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨਾ; ਦੂਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
In His grace He gave the sword of wisdom; charging, one kills the demons. ॥9॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ; ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥
Chant the chant of the Lord — this is the chant to chant;
win (the battle) and come to dwell in your own home.
ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ. ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ; ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
You will not see the hells of the 8.4 million species; with love, love, sing His praises. ॥10॥
He is the Saviour of continents and galaxies,
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
One on whom God shows His mercy, that servant meditates on Him. ॥11॥
Breaking his bonds, God has bought him,
and in His mercy made him a slave of His house.
ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ; ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
The unstruck tinkling melody of poise resounds; he does true work. ॥12॥
Faith in You has formed in the mind, O God;
the ego and "mine" mentality have been destroyed.
ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ; ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
My God has taken him as His own; his glory is beautiful in the world. ॥13॥
Proclaim the victory of the Lord of the world, and meditate on Him;
ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਈਸੈ ॥
I am ever a sacrifice to my God and Lord.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ; ਏਕਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Without Him no other is seen; the One pervades the whole world. ॥14॥
One who has known God as true, true, true —
by the Guru's grace his mind is ever imbued.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਏਕੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Remembering, remembering You, Your servants live; they merge in the One Creator. ॥15॥
our Master is the Saviour of all.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
Remembering the Name, all wishes are fulfilled; He has preserved the honour of servant Nanak. ॥16॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The bride (body) clings to her companion, the yogi (soul);
she remains entangled, enjoying pleasures and delights.
ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ; ਕਰਤੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
By the union of past deeds they have come together, enjoying pleasures and sports. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਧਨ ਤਤੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Whatever the husband does, the bride accepts at once;
the husband adorns the bride and keeps her with him.
ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਤ੍ਰ, ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Joined together, they dwell day and night; the husband gives the bride comfort. ॥2॥
ਧਨ ਮਾਗੈ; ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
When the bride asks, the husband runs about in many ways;
whatever he finds, he brings and shows her.
ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਧਨ ਰਹਤੀ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
One thing he cannot reach, and the bride's hunger and thirst remain. ॥3॥
ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਉ; ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਜੋਰੈ ॥
The bride makes her plea with both palms pressed together:
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹੁ; ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
"Beloved, do not go to foreign lands; stay in my home.
ਐਸਾ ਬਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Carry on such trade within the home that my hunger and thirst may be relieved." ॥4॥
Through the ages people have performed all sorts of rituals,
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ; ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ. ਨਹੀ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
but without the Lord's essence not a particle of peace was found.
ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ; ਤਉ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Nanak, when grace came in the true congregation, the bride and husband enjoyed bliss and delight. ॥5॥
1073: The bride is blind; the husband is fickle and clever,
engaged in the play of the five elements.
ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਹਹੁ; ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
The merchandise for which you came is obtained from the True Guru. ॥6॥
ਧਨ ਕਹੈ. ਤੂ ਵਸੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
ਤੁਝੈ ਬਿਨਾ. ਹਉ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ, ਨ ਲੇਖੈ; ਵਚਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ. ਨ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Without you I am of no account; give me your word that you will not leave me." ॥7॥
The husband says, "I am a slave of the command;
ਓਹੁ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਜਿਸੁ. ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
He is the great Lord, who fears no one and depends on no one.
ਜਿਚਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਣਾ; ਜਾ ਸਦੇ ਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
As long as He keeps me, I shall stay with you; when He calls, I shall rise and depart." ॥8॥
ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਕਹੇ; ਧਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
When the husband speaks true words to the bride,
ਧਨ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਸਮਝੈ; ਚੰਚਲਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
the fickle, immature bride understands nothing.
ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਓਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Again and again she begs for her husband's company; she takes his words as a joke. ॥9॥
The order comes; the husband is summoned;
ਨਾ ਧਨ ਪੁਛੀ; ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
he does not ask the bride, nor consult her.
ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਛੂਟਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ; ਦੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
He rises and departs, and the clay (body) is abandoned; see, Nanak, attachment is false. ॥10॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਭੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
O greedy mind, listen, my mind:
serve the True Guru day and night, forever.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਪਚਿ ਮੂਏ ਸਾਕਤ; ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Without the True Guru the faithless rot and die; the noose of Death is around the necks of those without a Guru. ॥11॥
The self-willed comes, the self-willed goes;
the self-willed is struck again and again.
ਜਿਤਨੇ ਨਰਕ. ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਪੁ. ਨ ਮਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
The self-willed suffers as many hells as there are; the Guru-facing is not touched in the slightest. ॥12॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ; ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
He alone is Guru-facing who is pleasing to the dear Lord;
ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ; ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
who can erase the one whom God has robed in honour?
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਨੰਦੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਪਇਆ, ਗਲਿ ਖਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The blissful one ever enjoys bliss — on whom the special robe of honour is placed around the neck. ॥13॥
I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru,
ਸਰਣਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ; ਬਚਨ ਕੇ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
Giver of sanctuary, heroic in keeping His word.
ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿ. ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
I have met such a God, the Giver of peace, that I shall never be separated and go anywhere. ॥14॥
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
O Treasure of virtues, Your worth cannot be found;
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
You pervade each and every heart, in all places.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ; ਹਉ ਰੇਣ. ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੨॥
Nanak seeks Your refuge, O Destroyer of the pain of the meek; may I be the dust of those who are Your slaves. ॥15॥1॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ; ਸਿਰ ਸਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
He is fully present in every heart, judging each and every one.
ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਕੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ. ਹੇ ॥੧॥
The True Master is over the heads of kings; there is no other at all. ॥1॥
He is joyful, infinite and merciful;
God is manifest, giving light to all.
ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
He makes forms, beholds them and rejoices; He Himself worships Himself. ॥2॥
He Himself creates nature and contemplates it;
the True One Himself makes the expanse.
ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
He Himself makes the plays play day and night; He Himself listens and listens, and is pleased. ॥3॥
True is His throne, true His sovereignty;
true is His treasury, true His rule.
1074: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ. ਧਾਰਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
He Himself is True; He has established all as true; the Truest of the true pervades. ॥4॥
True is the justice of the True One;
true is Your place forever, O God.
ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
True is Your creation, true Your Word; O True Master, You have created peace. ॥5॥
You alone are the great King;
by the True One's command all tasks are fulfilled.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
He knows everything within and without; He Himself is pleased with Himself. ॥6॥
ਤੂ ਵਡ ਰਸੀਆ. ਤੂ ਵਡ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
You are the great enjoyer, the great reveller;
You are detached, You alone are the yogi.
ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ; ਅਮਿਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
All peace and poise are in Your home; nectar is in Your glance. ॥7॥
Your gifts come from You alone;
You give gifts to all creatures in all worlds.
ਤੋਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Your treasury is full and never runs short; all remain satisfied and fulfilled. ॥8॥
Siddhas, seekers and forest-dwellers beg from You;
the celibate, the truthful and those at peace beg from You.
ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ. ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ; ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
You are the one Giver, all are beggars; You give gifts to the whole universe. ॥9॥
They worship the Infinite and enjoy His love;
in an instant He establishes and disestablishes.
ਭਾਰੋ ਤੋਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਭਗਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The Infinite Master is weighty beyond measure; obeying His command one becomes His devotee. ॥10॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ; ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One to whom You give Your vision knows You;
ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
through the Guru's Word he ever enjoys Your love.
ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋਈ; ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਵੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
He alone is clever, beautiful and wise who is pleasing to Your mind. ॥11॥
One in whose awareness You come is carefree;
ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ; ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
one in whose awareness You come is a true banker.
ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ. ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
One in whose awareness You come — what fear can he have? What can anyone do to him? ॥12॥
Craving is quenched, and he is cool within;
the Perfect Guru has taken the broken one and joined him (to the Lord).
ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ; ਅਮਿਉ ਝੋਲਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Awareness of the Word has awakened in his heart; he drinks the nectar, savouring it again and again. ॥13॥
ਮਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
He does not die; he lives forever and ever;
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ. ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
He neither comes nor goes; the Guru has dispelled his doubt. ॥14॥
Through the perfect bani of the Perfect Guru
one attached to the Perfect One merges in the Perfect One.
ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰੰਗਾ; ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤੋਲੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Day by day his love increases by a quarter; weighed, it does not decrease. ॥15॥
He has been made pure as twelve-carat gold;
in the Assayer's glance his colour is true.
ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਰਾਫੀ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾਈਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
Assaying it, the Assayer places it in the treasury; it is not heated again. ॥16॥
Your Name is nectar, O Master;
Your slave Nanak is ever a sacrifice.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੧॥੩॥
In the company of the saints I have found great peace; seeing Your vision, this mind is drenched. ॥17॥1॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The Guru is the Sustainer of the world; the Guru is the Lord of the universe;
the Guru is merciful, ever forgiving.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਸਥਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
The Guru is the Shastras, Simritis and the six rituals; the Guru is the sacred shrine. ॥1॥
1075: Remembering the Guru, all sins are destroyed;
ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਜਮ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਫਾਸਹਿ ॥
remembering the Guru, one is not caught in Death's noose.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Remembering the Guru, the mind becomes pure; the Guru cuts away dishonour. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਨਰਕਿ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
The Guru's servant does not go to hell;
the Guru's servant meditates on the Transcendent Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
The Guru's servant finds the company of the holy; the Guru ever grants the gift of life. ॥3॥
At the Guru's door the Lord's kirtan is heard;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
meeting the True Guru, one chants the Lord's praise with the mouth.
ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The True Guru erases strife and suffering, and grants honour in the Lord's court. ॥4॥
The Guru has shown the Inaccessible, Imperceptible One;
the True Guru has put the stray one on the path.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ. ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ, ਭਗਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
No obstacle blocks the Guru's servant in devotion; the Lord has firmly implanted perfect wisdom in him. ॥5॥
The Guru has shown Him in all places,
the Lord of the world, pervading water and land.
ਊਚ ਊਨ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ; ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
High and low are all alike to Him; the mind is fixed in meditation in poise. ॥6॥
Meeting the Guru, all craving is quenched;
meeting the Guru, Maya does not watch over (overpower) one.
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ, ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ, ਪੀ ਪਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
The Perfect Guru has given truth and contentment; one drinks and gives others the nectar of the Name. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
He Himself heard it and Himself proclaimed it.
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਸਤ੍ਰੇ; ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Those who chanted it were all saved; they attained the unshakeable place. ॥8॥
The glory of the True Guru the True Guru alone knows;
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
whatever He does, He does in His own will.
ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ. ਜਾਚਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੯॥੧॥੪॥
Your servants beg for the dust of the holy; Nanak is ever a sacrifice. ॥9॥1॥4॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
God, the Primal, Immaculate, Formless One,
pervades all, yet is Himself detached.
ਵਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ; ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
He has no colour, caste or mark; by His command He creates the whole universe. ॥1॥
God has given glory to the human being.
ਇਸੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੂਕੈ; ਸੋ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
One who misses this step comes and goes and suffers pain. ॥2॥
What can be said of what is made?
Through the Guru the treasure of the Name is obtained.
ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭੂਲੈ; ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ. ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
One whom He Himself leads astray goes astray; he understands whom He gives understanding. ॥3॥
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਨਗਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
He has made this (body) a town of joy and sorrow;
those who seek the True Guru's refuge are saved.
ਤ੍ਰਿਹਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
One who remains detached from the three qualities is a Guru-facing one who obtains glory. ॥4॥
One may perform very many rituals,
but whatever is done becomes a fetter on the feet.
ਕੁਰੁਤਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ. ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮੈ; ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ. ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Seed sown out of season does not sprout; one loses all profit and the capital too. ॥5॥
In the Kaliyug kirtan is supreme;
through the Guru, meditate on Him with attention.
1076: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ. ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
He himself swims across and carries all his generations across; he goes to the Lord's court with honour. ॥6॥
Continents, nether regions, islands and all worlds —
ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ; ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
God Himself has placed them all under death's sway.
ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ. ਜੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The One imperishable Lord alone is unmoving; one who meditates on Him becomes unmoving too. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
The Lord's servant becomes like the Lord;
do not think him different because of his human body.
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
As waves of many kinds rise from water, and then water merges again in water. ॥8॥
A beggar begs for alms at His door;
ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
when it pleases God, He shows mercy.
ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ. ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
"Grant me Your vision, by which my mind may be satisfied"; in the Lord's kirtan the mind is steadied. ॥9॥
ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਕਿਤੈ ਵਸਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
The beautiful Lord is not won over by any means,
ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
yet the Lord does whatever pleases His saints.
ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਨਿ. ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇਨਿ; ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Whatever they wish to be done, they have Him do; at His door no one blocks their way. ॥10॥
ਜਿਥੈ; ਅਉਘਟੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Wherever a hard situation arises, O mortal,
there meditate on the Lord, the Holder of the bow.
ਜਿਥੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ. ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਈ; ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Where neither son nor wife nor any friend can help, there the Lord Himself rescues. ॥11॥
The great Master is inaccessible and unfathomable;
how can the Carefree God be met?
ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ; ਸੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
One whose noose He cuts and puts on the path comes to dwell in the congregation. ॥12॥
One who understands His command is called His servant;
bad and good alike, both are to be borne.
ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
When ego departs, one understands the One; such a Guru-facing one merges in poise. ॥13॥
The Lord's devotees ever dwell in peace;
like innocent children, they are detached and unattached.
ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ; ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਲਾਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
They enjoy many delights of many kinds, as a father fondles his son. ॥14॥
He is inaccessible, imperceptible; His worth cannot be found;
He is met only when He unites one with Himself.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Through the Guru He is revealed to those on whose foreheads such destiny was written from the start. ॥15॥
You Yourself are the Creator, the Cause of causes;
creating the universe, You support the whole earth.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੫॥
Servant Nanak has entered the refuge at the Lord's door; as it pleases the Lord, He preserves honour. ॥16॥1॥5॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Whatever is seen is You alone;
it is Your word that is heard with the ears.
ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ. ਨ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਕਾਈ; ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
No other at all is seen; all is Your support (creation). ॥1॥
He Himself takes care of His creation;
God Himself, all by Himself, has become all.
ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ; ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
He Himself created and fashioned the expanse; He Himself cares for every heart. ॥2॥
Some He created with great courts,
1077: ਇਕਿ ਭੂਖੇ. ਇਕਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ; ਸਭਸੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
some hungry, some satisfied and fulfilled; all depend on Your support. ॥3॥
He Himself is true, true, true, the True One;
through and through He is blended with His devotees.
ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ. ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ; ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
He Himself is hidden, He Himself is manifest; He has spread Himself out. ॥4॥
He is forever and ever, ever to be;
ਊਣੇ ਭਰੇ. ਭਰੇ ਭਰਿ ਊਣੇ; ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੫॥
He fills the empty and empties the full — these are the wonders of the Master's doing. ॥5॥
With my mouth may I praise the True King;
with my eyes may I behold the Inaccessible, Unfathomable One;
ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ; ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
hearing with my ears, my mind and body bloom; my Master is the Saviour of all. ॥6॥
Creating and creating, You watch over Your creation;
all beings and creatures meditate on Him.
ਅਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ; ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਣਾ ॥੭॥
He alone knows His own creative power; the Gracious One beholds all with His glance. ॥7॥
ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜਹ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
Where the society of saints sits beside God,
in bliss and joy, (recounting) the Lord's wonderful plays,
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਣਾ ॥੮॥
they sing His praises in the unstruck melody of the bani; there may slave Nanak remember Him. ॥8॥
Coming and going is all Your play;
the Infinite One creates and watches the play.
ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ; ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਲਣਾ ॥੯॥
The Creator Himself creates; He cherishes what He has made. ॥9॥
Hearing, hearing of Your glory, I live;
forever and ever I am a sacrifice.
ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ. ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
With palms pressed together I remember You day and night, my inaccessible, infinite Master. ॥10॥
Without You, whom else could I praise?
I meditate on the One alone in my mind.
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ. ਜਨ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ; ਇਹ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
Understanding Your command, Your servants are in rapture — this is the devotees' labour. ॥11॥
Through the Guru's teaching, meditate on the True One in the mind;
through the Guru's teaching one is blended in the Lord's love.
ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ. ਤੁਟਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ; ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
Through the Guru's teaching all bonds are broken; this doubt and attachment are burnt away. ॥12॥
Wherever He keeps one, that is the place of peace;
whatever happens in His will, one accepts as good.
ਬਿਨਸੇ ਬੈਰ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ; ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
Enmity is ended; no one is an enemy; one sees the One in all. ॥13॥
Fears are dispelled and darkness destroyed;
God, the detached Primal Being, has become manifest.
ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
Abandoning self, one enters His refuge, and labours for Him to whom one belongs. ॥14॥
Rare is such a fortunate one born
who has meditated on the Master twenty-four hours a day.
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ; ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੫॥
In the company of such a person everyone is carried across; he is the support of his family. ॥15॥
May I obtain this blessing from the Master:
that twenty-four hours a day, with palms joined, I meditate on Him,
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਲੈ ਉਚਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੬॥
that I chant the Name and merge in poise in the Name; may Nanak be blessed to utter the Name. ॥16॥1॥6॥
Seeing outward forms, do not be deceived, O fool;
this is a false attachment, a false expanse.
ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਰਹਣੁ. ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੧॥
In the world no one gets to stay; only the One Lord is unmoving. ॥1॥
Seek the refuge of the Perfect Guru;
He erases attachment, sorrow and all doubt.
ਏਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਗਾਇਣਾ ॥੨॥
He implants the one mantra and medicine: sing the True Name in the heart. ॥2॥
1078: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਉ; ਤਰਸਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
The Name for which many gods long,
ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੩॥
the Master of the masterless, Destroyer of the pain of the meek — He is found through the Perfect Guru. ॥3॥
No other door can be perceived;
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
though one wanders the three worlds, one understands nothing.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਿਸੁ; ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੪॥
The True Guru is the Banker who holds the treasury of the Name; this jewel is obtained from Him. ॥4॥
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ; ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
whom angels, men and gods cannot find, O friend —
ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੫॥
the True Being, the True Guru, the Transcendent Lord — meeting Him one is carried across. ॥5॥
If you long for the wish-fulfilling Elysian tree, O beloved mind,
and the wish-fulfilling cow to grace your court,
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੬॥
then serve the Perfect Guru, (find) satisfaction and contentment, and practise the Name, the source of all elixirs. ॥6॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਮਰਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ॥
Through the Guru's Word the five passions die;
in the fear of the Transcendent Lord you will become pure.
ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਣਾ ॥੭॥
When one meets the Perfect Guru, the philosopher's stone, touching Him, (the Lord) is shown. ॥7॥
the wise one renounces even paltry liberation.
ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੮॥
The One Creator is obtained through the True Guru; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru's vision. ॥8॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ; ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
No one knows (the worth of) service to the Guru;
the Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Imperceptible One.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ. ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇਣਾ ॥੯॥
One whom He attaches is the servant, with great good fortune on his forehead. ॥9॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਬੇਦ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
Even the Vedas do not know the Guru's glory;
they describe only a trifle, from hearsay.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
The True Guru is the Transcendent Lord, beyond the beyond; remembering Him, the mind is cooled. ॥10॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ; ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Hearing of His glory, the mind lives;
when He dwells in the heart, it becomes cool.
ਗੁਰੁਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ. ਤਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
One who chants (the Name) through the Guru's mouth obtains glory, and is not put on Death's path. ॥11॥
I have entered the refuge of the saints,
and placed my soul, breath and wealth before them.
ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਾਈ; ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰਮਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
I know nothing of service or awareness; show mercy to this worm. ॥12॥
Merge me, the virtueless, with them;
in Your mercy, attach me to their service.
ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਉ ਪੀਸਉ. ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ; ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
I would wave the fan and grind the grain before the saints; washing their feet, I find peace. ॥13॥
Wandering, wandering through many doors I have come;
by Your grace I have come to Your refuge.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਏਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
Forever and ever keep me with the saints; grant me this gift of the Name. ॥14॥
My Lord of the world has become merciful;
I have obtained the vision of the Perfect True Guru.
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੭॥
I have peace, poise and lasting bliss; Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ॥15॥2॥7॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The earth and sky remember Him;
the moon and sun remember the Treasure of virtues;
ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
air, water and fire remember Him; the whole creation remembers Him. ॥1॥
1079: All continents, islands and worlds remember Him;
the nether regions and cities remember Him, the True One;
ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ. ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
the sources of creation remember Him, the forms of speech remember Him, all the Lord's servants remember Him. ॥2॥
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva remember Him;
the three hundred thirty million gods remember Him;
ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਖੵਿ, ਦੈਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਅਗਨਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਸੁ ਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
the yakshas and all the demons remember Him; His countless praise cannot be counted. ॥3॥
All beasts, birds and creatures remember Him;
forests, mountains and hermits remember Him;
ਲਤਾ ਬਲੀ, ਸਾਖ ਸਭ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ, ਸਭ ਮਨਾ ॥੪॥
vines, branches and all remember Him; the Master pervades all minds. ॥4॥
All creatures, gross and subtle, remember Him;
Siddhas and seekers remember the Lord's mantra;
ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨਾ ॥੫॥
the hidden and the manifest remember You, my God; You are the Lord of all worlds. ॥5॥
Men and women in all stages of life remember Him;
all castes and colours of beings remember Him;
ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਬੇਤੇ; ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰੈਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੬॥
the virtuous, the clever and all the wise remember Him; they remember Him night and day. ॥6॥
Hours, minutes, moments and instants remember Him;
death and life, purity and purification remember Him;
ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ; ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੭॥
omens, Shastras and astrology remember Him; the Unseen cannot be seen even for an instant. ॥7॥
O Master, Doer and Cause of all,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਾ ॥੮॥
those whom You mercifully attach to devotion win the treasure of this human birth. ॥8॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
One in whose mind his own God dwells,
ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
by perfect grace chants the Guru's chant.
ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਰੁਨਾ ॥੯॥
He knows God as pervading all, and never again weeps wandering through births. ॥9॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
One in whose mind the Guru's Word dwells —
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
his pain, suffering and doubt flee.
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ; ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
Peace, poise and bliss, the essence of the Name; the unstruck bani resounds with the melody of poise. ॥10॥
He alone is wealthy who has meditated on God;
he alone is honourable who has found the company of the holy;
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ; ਸੋ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ, ਨਾ ਛਿਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
one in whose mind the Transcendent Lord dwells is of perfect destiny, and not hidden (renowned). ॥11॥
That Master pervades water, land and sky;
ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ, ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
The ointment of the Guru's wisdom has cut away all doubt; none is seen but the One. ॥12॥
Highest of the high is Your court;
ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
it cannot be described; it has no end or limit.
ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ. ਅਥਾਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਅਤੁਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਿਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
Deep, profound, unfathomable Master, You are unweighable; how can You be measured? ॥13॥
You are the Creator; all is made by You;
ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੀਆ ॥
without You there is no other.
ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ; ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
In the beginning, middle and end, You alone, O God; the whole expanse is Your own self. ॥14॥
The messenger of Death does not come near him
who sings the Lord's kirtan in the company of the holy.
ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ; ਜੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
All his wishes are fulfilled who hears God's praise with his ears. ॥15॥
ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
You belong to all, and all are Yours,
O True Master, deep and profound.
1080: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ; ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਮਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੮॥
Says Nanak, those people alone are sublime who are pleasing to Your mind, O Master. ॥16॥1॥8॥
O all-powerful God, Giver of all peace,
be merciful, that I may remember Your Name.
ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ. ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ; ਜਨੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ. ਜਾਚੰਗਨਾ ॥੧॥
The Lord is the Giver; all beings and creatures are beggars; His servant begs and longs (for the Name). ॥1॥
ਮਾਗਉ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
I beg for the dust of His servants, that I may attain the supreme state,
and erase the filth of countless births.
ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੨॥
Chronic diseases are cured by the Lord's medicine; I beg to be dyed in the Lord, the Pure One. ॥2॥
With my ears may I hear the pure praises of the Master;
with Your support alone, may I renounce the poison of lust.
ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ; ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
Bowing low, may I fall at the feet of Your slaves, never hesitating to do this good deed. ॥3॥
May my tongue sing Your praises, O Lord,
that the faults I have committed may be erased.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ. ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ; ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤਜਿ ਤੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
Remembering, remembering the Master, my mind lives, rid of the torment of the five demons. ॥4॥
Meditating on His lotus feet, board the ship;
joining the company of the saints, cross the ocean.
ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ. ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਨੰਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
The worship and reverence (of Him) is to know the Lord dwelling equally in all; one is not stripped naked in births again. ॥5॥
ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ; ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
Make me the slave of Your slaves, O Lord of the world,
O Treasure of mercy, merciful to the meek.
ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਮਿਲੁ. ਕਦੇ, ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
O Perfect Transcendent Lord, my friend and helper, meet me, that I may never be separated. ॥6॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
One who has offered mind and body before the Lord,
though asleep for countless births, awakens.
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ. ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ; ਹਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੰਤਨਾ ॥੭॥
He to whom one belongs becomes one's Sustainer; one has killed and abandoned murderous ego. ॥7॥
The Inner-knower pervades water and land;
the undeceivable Master permeates every heart.
ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਖੋਈ. ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੰਗਨਾ ॥੮॥
The Perfect Guru has torn down the wall of doubt; the One is seen pervading all. ॥8॥
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
Wherever I look, there is God, the Ocean of peace;
the Lord's treasuries, the mine of jewels, never run short.
ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਹ. ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ, ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੰਗਨਾ ॥੯॥
Ungraspable, unfathomable, no limit of Him can be found; he understands on whom He is merciful. ॥9॥
The heart is cool, the mind and body soothed;
the burning of birth and death is erased.
ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ; ਅਮਿਓ ਧਾਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
Taking them by the hand, my God has pulled them out, casting His nectar glance. ॥10॥
The One alone pervades all places;
without Him there is no other.
ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ, ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਭਰਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
In the beginning, middle and end God pervades; craving and doubt are quenched. ॥11॥
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord; the Guru is the Lord of the universe;
the Guru is the Creator; the Guru is ever forgiving.
ਗੁਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਜਪਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
Chanting the chant the Guru gave, I obtained the fruit — the lamp of wisdom in the company of the saints. ॥12॥
ਜੋ ਪੇਖਾ; ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Whatever I see is all the Master;
ਜੋ ਸੁਨਣਾ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
whatever I hear is God's word.
ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ. ਸੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ; ਸਰਣਿ ਸਹਾਈ, ਸੰਤਹ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
Whatever is done, You cause to be done; You are the helper of those in Your refuge, the support of the saints. ॥13॥
The beggar begs from You and worships You;
O Purifier of sinners, Perfect, Holy God,
ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੁ. ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ; ਆਨ ਮੰਗਨ. ਨਿਹਕਿੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
grant me this one gift, O Treasure of all peace and virtue; asking for anything else is worthless. ॥14॥
